verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents API access tokens that can be scoped to restrict which operations they perform, such as building a read-only integration. This shows a first-party public API for programmatic control. The CLI and MCP server, which manage flags, projects, environments and other resources, are separate capabilities that point the same way. The failed OpenAPI probe only shows the spec isn't at the common root paths; it does not contradict that an API exists. Missing for 10: a cited API reference documenting endpoints and coverage, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
